annotations.title: Get the Daily Reference Rate (16:00 London)

description: AllRatesToday's once-a-day, never-revised mid-market rate: the per-currency median of five samples in a five-minute window centred on 16:00 London, published each business day. Use it when the user needs ONE reproducible rate per day — index levels, return series, research datasets, month-end reports — rather than a live quote (get_exchange_rate) or an institution's official rate (get_official_rates). Keyless: returns the latest table, or one pair with source/target (cross via USD, flagged derived). With a key, `date` returns the table for a past business day. Not the WM/Refinitiv fix and not a registered benchmark — relay the disclaimer and the rate_date.

date.description: Optional past business day, YYYY-MM-DD (API key, paid plan). Omit for the latest table.

source.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.

target.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.
